name: USDB Blast
oneLiner: USDB is Blast L2's native yield-bearing dollar, bridged USDC/USDT routed through MakerDAO DSR with auto-rebasing yield to Blast holders.
collateral: DAI held through Blast's MakerDAO DSR yield manager; USDC, USDT, and DAI are supported bridge deposit inputs, while USDB withdrawals redeem to DAI.
pegMechanism: Automatic rebasing with yield from underlying centralized stablecoin strategies

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Blast documentation establishes the USDB route and yield-bearing reserve framework, but the reviewed sources do not provide the complete current assurance, reconciliation, custody continuity, valuation, seniority, and loss-recovery inputs required for a full mechanism review.
